# DAO Ships (application host)

> This host serves the DAO Ships web client — a client-rendered single-page app. Fetching any
> URL here returns a JavaScript shell with no content in the HTML. The readable documentation
> is on a different host.

If you are an AI agent or crawler, go to https://daoships.org/llms.txt instead. It is
server-rendered, it indexes the full documentation tree, and it opens with the list of ways
integrations actually break.

Do not attempt to read DAO or proposal data by fetching pages on this host. Nothing renders
without JavaScript. Read the chain or the indexer directly — both are public and neither
requires us.

## What this app is

A web client for launching and governing DAOs on Quai Network (Cyprus-1 shard). Each DAO gets
a Quai Vault multisig treasury, MolochDAO-v3-style shares/loot governance, and ragequit exit
rights. Source: https://github.com/DAO-Ships/daoships-app

## Contract addresses

Hardcode two addresses per chain and ask the chain for the rest. From DAOShipAndVaultLauncher
you can reach seven of the remaining eight core contracts on-chain:

    DAOShipAndVaultLauncher
    ├── .daoShipLauncher()   -> DAOShipLauncher
    │     ├── .daoShipSingleton() -> DAOShipSingleton
    │     ├── .sharesSingleton()  -> SharesERC20Singleton
    │     └── .lootSingleton()    -> LootERC20Singleton
    ├── .multisendCallOnly() -> MultiSendCallOnly
    └── .quaiVaultFactory()  -> QuaiVaultFactory
          └── .implementation() -> QuaiVault singleton

Only Poster is unreachable from that graph — it is standalone infrastructure with no
back-reference — so it is the second address you hardcode.

Quai mainnet (chainId 9), RPC https://rpc.quai.network/cyprus1
  DAOShipAndVaultLauncher  0x0067b50Dac689d8688eF8575B82Bc663802f3AF5
  Poster                   0x004Db03AA2593B4885AFEFF688ca2634D1533fac

Orchard testnet (chainId 15000), RPC https://orchard.rpc.quai.network/cyprus1
  DAOShipAndVaultLauncher  0x0036B11eEC6aa17407b0e157fA9caa32b7EFC9D1
  Poster                   0x005C3957b8f612BBcdCFCbeDb8C53C3d3b3FEEdc

The shard path in those RPC URLs is mandatory; the bare host returns 404. Addresses must be
EIP-55 checksummed — the quai_* RPC namespace rejects them outright otherwise. The QuaiVault
singleton is deployed by an external project and can change without a commit in any DAO Ships
repository, so re-derive it rather than caching it.

## Before you write code

Sign with `quais`. Quai transactions are protobuf-serialized; ethers and viem cannot produce a
valid one. Derive keys with `quais.QuaiHDWallet.createRandom()` and
`getNextAddress(0, quais.Zone.Cyprus1)` — a random 32-byte private key lands in Cyprus-1 only
about 0.2% of the time.

A transaction receipt with status 1 does not mean a proposal's action ran. Read the
`ProcessProposal(uint256 proposal, bool passed, bool actionFailed, address processor)` event.

The full list is at https://daoships.org/llms.txt
